necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks. Given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
